title: Locker Rental: damage and lost-key charge rule
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Locker Rental product line. It states the rule by which damage to a locker and a lost key or fob are billed on the rental. The specific damage fee and lost-key fee that this rule reads for a given tier are fixed in the Locker Rental damage, lost key and key replacement terms; this document states only the charging rule itself.

## Rule
Damage to the locker is charged the tier's damage fee, and a lost key or fob is charged the tier's lost-key fee; each is billed as its own one-time charge, distinct from, and in addition to, the rental's recurring monthly fee.

## Equivalent restatement (input, judgement, charge)
- Input: damage to the locker is reported. Judgement: a one-time damage charge applies. Charge: the tier's damage fee, separate from the monthly fee.
- Input: a key or fob is reported lost. Judgement: a one-time lost-key charge applies. Charge: the tier's lost-key fee, separate from the monthly fee.
- Input: both a damage report and a lost-key report occur for the same rental. Judgement: each is its own one-time charge, since the rule states them as distinct charges rather than one combined charge; both the damage fee and the lost-key fee are billed.

## Points of judgement
Neither the damage charge nor the lost-key charge replaces or reduces the recurring monthly fee for the billing cycle in which it is billed; the rule states both as one-time charges distinct from that recurring fee, not as a substitute for it.
